relationships.subject: ACC GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: chemogenetic activation of GABAergic neurons in the ACC alleviated chronic inflammatory pain and pain-induced anxiety-like behaviors, enhanced inhibitory presynaptic transmission, and reduced the excitability of ACC PNs

relationships.subject: ACC GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Chemogenetic inhibition of GABAergic neurons in the ACC led to pain-induced anxiety-like behaviors, reduced inhibitory presynaptic transmission, and enhanced the excitability of ACC PNs but had no effect on pain in normal rats

relationships.subject: muscimol
relationships.evidence_quote: intra-ACC injection of the GABA<sub>A</sub>R agonist muscimol relieved anxiety-like behaviors but had no effect on chronic inflammatory pain

relationships.subject: picrotoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: Intra-ACC injection of the GABA<sub>A</sub>R antagonist picrotoxin induced anxiety-like behaviors but had no effect on pain in normal rats

relationships.subject: CFA
relationships.evidence_quote: The number of PV positive cells in the bilateral ACC layer V was decreased in the model rats

key_findings: Chemogenetic activation of ACC GABAergic neurons reduced ACC pyramidal neuron excitability, enhanced sIPSC frequency and relieved CFA-induced pain and anxiety-like behavior; inhibition induced anxiety in naive rats.
CFA chronic inflammatory pain reduced inhibitory presynaptic transmission onto ACC layer V PNs without changing GAD65/67 cell number; intra-ACC muscimol relieved anxiety but not pain.
